summary: This PR finishes the post-ADR-0005 hardening of the Project Summary template loader: it extracts `FieldDef`/`FieldCondition` and their runtime guards out of the 800-line tab into a testable `utils/projectSummarySchema.ts`, widens `FieldCondition.value` to optional/nullable so a legitimately valueless condition no longer causes the whole saved template to be discarded, stops `(undefined)` leaking into exported CSV/XLSX/PDF, and adds 23 unit tests that deliberately assert both directions (reject what crashes, accept everything the app writes). The `package.json` change is script-only (`build:e2e` drops a now-vestigial `--mode e2e`), so the absent lockfile change is correct, and the ADR edit resolves a self-contradiction about TD-026. I verified the widened `value` type still narrows correctly at every consumer (`ProjectSummaryTab.tsx:253`, `:256`, `:322`, `:700`, `:711`, `:732`) — no new `any`, no unchecked assertion, and the extraction moves logic in the handbook-sanctioned direction (`components/` → `utils/`, with `utils/` importing nothing). Two non-blocking observations below; nothing here should hold the merge.
